title: Learn the circuit, keep the choice
description: Practice spends real resources for useful information. Every scenario permits skipping; no race performance bonus is awarded for participation.

scenarios.title: Spend a set to learn
scenarios.objective: Choose whether better tyre-life evidence is worth using a real set before a 12-lap race.
scenarios.hint: Optional practice: try MER on medium tyres and MOR on hard tyres. Wait for clear air to collect comparable laps. Or skip and retain stock; neither route grants a hidden bonus.

scenarios.title: Two setups, one question
scenarios.objective: Compare a current setup with a stable-wet alternative, without a hidden perfect score.
scenarios.hint: Practice on the same driver, compound and modes where possible. Different water, tyre age, fuel and traffic can confound a lap-time difference. The report distinguishes measured findings from estimates.
